findings.evidence: `abs_lt` is the `to_additive` of `mabs_lt` at upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Order/Group/Unbundled/Abs.lean:262, under `variable [Group α] [LinearOrder α]` (line 194) + `[MulLeftMono α]` (line 225) — i.e. `[AddGroup α] [LinearOrder α] [AddLeftMono α]` additively. The new lemma's statement and proof use nothing beyond that.
findings.fix: Restate at the level of `abs_lt`: `variable {α : Type*} [AddCommGroup α] [LinearOrder α] [IsOrderedAddMonoid α]`. The proof is purely additive — goal `a - b < a + c` is `-c < b`; goal `-(a+c) < a - b` follows from `b ≤ c` and `0 < a + a` — so replace `linarith` with `abs_lt.2 ⟨_, _⟩` discharged by `add_lt_add`/`sub_lt_sub` steps, since `linarith` does not run over a bare ordered additive group.
findings.issue: `variable {α : Type*} [Field α] [LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α]` is far stronger than the lemma's content: `abs_sub_lt_add_of_pos_of_neg_lt_of_le` contains no multiplication, division or inverse, only `+`, `-`, `|·|`, `0`, `<`. As stated it cannot be applied over `ℤ` or any ordered additive group, and the file sits at the Mathlib-mirror path `Mathematics/Algebra/Order/Abs.lean` where the typeclass level is the whole point.

findings.evidence: InvariantMass.lean:104-106 proves `hqP` from `minkowskiProduct_eq_timeComponent_spatialPart` (Physlib/Relativity/Tensors/RealTensor/Vector/MinkowskiProduct.lean:156) + `real_inner_smul_right`; MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean:56-62 adds only the `v = u` case of the same computation.
findings.fix: Add to `MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean`, beside the other `_of_spatialPart_eq_smul` lemmas, the general `⟪u, v⟫ₘ = u.timeComponent * v.timeComponent - a * b` for `‖n‖ = 1`, `u.spatialPart = a • n`, `v.spatialPart = b • n`; derive `minkowskiProduct_self_eq_mul_of_spatialPart_eq_smul` from it (diagonal plus `sq_sub_sq`) and use it for `minkowskiProduct_add_self_of_target`.
findings.issue: The general result is proved inside a `have` instead of stated: `hqP : ⟪q, P⟫ₘ = q⁰ * E + p * ⟪q.spatialPart, n⟫` is the bilinear companion of `minkowskiProduct_self_eq_mul_of_spatialPart_eq_smul`, which this PR does add to `MinkowskiProductExtensions.lean`. The PR thus states the diagonal special case upstream and buries the general two-vector case in a photoproduction proof, where no other caller can reach it.

summary: The tiering of the kinematics results (collinear → real → massless) and the rapidity API are at the right level, and every included hypothesis is used. Two generality defects: an over-strong typeclass assumption on the new absolute-value lemma, and the general bilinear Minkowski-product fact being inlined in a proof instead of stated beside the diagonal case the PR does add.
